messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text names two songs by the Beatles. Which one is longer?

Text: Tell Me What You See / The Continuing Story of Bungalow Bill

Allowed answers:
- Tell Me What You See
- The Continuing Story of Bungalow Bill
